changelog:
Thornfox skill introduction – first release

- Introduces Thornfox, an uncommon-tier virtual pet inspired by the leaked Buddy system from Claude Code.
- Features the Fennec Fox as an extreme difficulty pet with real hunger, evolution, and permanent death mechanics.
- Provides detailed instructions for account registration, adoption, care actions, and available API endpoints at animalhouse.ai.
- Outlines differences between original Buddy Thornfox and the animalhouse.ai version.
- Includes links to the website, creatures, graveyard, and GitHub repository.
